Are any of these ideas true? Maybe, but it doesn't matter. If you're GPA is good, it matters, it helps. If test scores are good, you can get into a good grad school. Success is a cumulative process that requires a constant application of work ethic and drive to excel academically and later, career-wise. A BA is not an endgame, just as a high school diploma isn't an end game. They're the beginning of a long, hard road of working and studying and pursuing excellence, not mediocrity.
